title: Government has asked us to reconsider restricting all protests to Freedom Park, says Bengaluru’s new Chief Commissioner of Police

ai.summary: Bengaluru's new Chief Commissioner of Police says the government has asked them to reconsider restricting all protests to Freedom Park, but no decision has been made.

facts.claim: The government has asked us to reconsider restricting all protests to Freedom Park alone
facts.quote: RH: The Home Minister has asked us to reconsider this. We are thinking on those lines, but no decision has been made yet.
